title: Cosmic Dragon Vortex
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a massive swirling cosmic dragon made of stars and galaxies in a purple vortex dominating the sky. In the foreground, stylized women in orange patterned dresses stand within stylized blue waves while a hooded wizard with a staff stands beside a giant mushroom topped by a large dragonfly under a stormy purple sky with lightning.
prompt: A surreal fantasy painting shows a gigantic cosmic dragon formed from stars, galaxies and nebulae swirling inside a massive purple and teal vortex in the stormy sky. In the foreground, multiple women wearing orange patterned dresses stand in stylized curling blue waves. A hooded wizard in a dark cloak holds a golden staff beside an enormous green mushroom with white spots, which is being landed on by a giant detailed dragonfly. Lightning illuminates the dramatic purple sky above distant mountains.
